title: SPORT CITY
description: SPORT CITY is a multifunctional residential complex on Batumi's New Boulevard (ONE Development): sport, hotel-style service and urban infrastructure in one project. Prices: from $45,000 per lot, from $1,450 per m² (indicative for launch sales; confirm with your manager). Layouts from studio to large apartments, landscaped grounds, sports zones and family recreation. Suitable for living, remote work and investment.
